up: List the IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha. For each matching activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, target ChEMBL ID, and target name. Only include results where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the associated document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha isoform'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
